heading: Need a referral or investigations?
body: If your assessment points to bloods, imaging, or a specialist opinion, we coordinate the referral and investigations for you.

heading: Is pain your main concern?
body: When pain is the primary presenting problem, a focused musculoskeletal and pain assessment is the right next step.

heading: Struggling with your mental health?
body: If mental health symptoms emerge during your consultation, a dedicated mental health assessment gives them the time they need.

heading: New neurological symptoms?
body: New-onset neurological symptoms that need specialist assessment are best seen by our neurology specialists.

heading: Is the patient a child?
body: Children are best assessed through our dedicated paediatric GP consultation.

heading: Cardiovascular condition needing specialist input?
body: Cardiovascular conditions that need specialist management are seen by our cardiology specialists.

heading: Complex mental health needs?
body: Complex mental health requiring specialist management and medication review is handled by our psychiatry specialists.

heading: Need structured dietary management?
body: Structured dietary management for chronic conditions is provided by our nutrition specialists.

heading: Chronic neurological condition?
body: Epilepsy, MS, neuropathy and other chronic neurological conditions are managed by our neurology specialists.

heading: Looking for talking therapy?
body: For therapy and structured psychological intervention, our psychology specialists can help.

heading: Need specialist medication management?
body: Complex mental health and specialist medication management is provided by our psychiatry specialists.

heading: Want a structured nutrition plan?
body: Structured dietary assessment and planning is provided by our nutrition specialists.

heading: Managing a metabolic condition?
body: Metabolic conditions that need ongoing management are best handled through our chronic disease consultation.

heading: Need physiotherapy or rehab?
body: Chronic pain and musculoskeletal conditions often benefit from structured physiotherapy and rehabilitation.

heading: Not sure you need a neurologist?
body: Many symptoms can be assessed and managed at GP level first. Start with a medical consultation and we'll refer you if specialist care is needed.

heading: Not sure you need a cardiologist?
body: If you're unsure whether you need specialist input, a GP assessment is the right place to start.

heading: Not sure you need a psychiatrist?
body: Start with a mental health consultation — your doctor will advise whether specialist psychiatric care is needed.

heading: Not sure where to start?
body: A mental health consultation helps clarify whether psychology, psychiatry, or GP-level support fits you best.

heading: Focused on weight?
body: If weight is your main goal, our weight management consultation combines clinical and nutritional support.

heading: Not sure you need a paediatric specialist?
body: Most childhood concerns are assessed first through our paediatric GP consultation.

heading: Need a diagnosis first?
body: If you need your pain assessed and diagnosed before rehab, start with a musculoskeletal and pain assessment.
